The Hudson Row Hotel

Welcome to The Hudson Row Hotel — a four-star boutique stay in the heart of Manhattan's west side. Our guests love the quiet rooms, the skyline views and the easy walk to the High Line, Hudson Yards and the Javits Center.

Hotel Facilities

Rooftop bar, 24-hour fitness centre, business centre, concierge, pet-friendly rooms, laundry and dry cleaning, and a complimentary breakfast every morning.

Check-in & policies

Check-in time: 3:00 PM. Check out: 11 AM.

Cancellations are free until 48 hours before arrival; after that the first night is charged.

Pets are welcome with a one-time fee.
